title: An integrative workflow for lncRNA orthology detection and its application to 13 evolutionarily diverse species.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Zenodo record 20842578 via API: one file, lncrna_PutOrtho-v1.0.0.zip, 113,004 bytes, CC-BY-4.0, which is source code only. GitHub repo file tree: R/shell scripts plus tiny example outputs (each under 2 KB, 3 toy species). Europe PMC supplementary file listing timed out, so the ortholog tables in the supplement were not retrieved.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: 18,859 human lncRNAs (long non-coding RNAs) as reference; ~200 putative orthologs per species (stringent) to ~5,000 (relaxed); 1,555 human-chicken one-to-one pairs; expression data on the GEGA website (gega.sigenae.org).

a1_downloadable.note: Zenodo deposit is only a 113 KB code archive (checked). The orthology atlas itself is presumably in NAR supplementary tables, which could not be retrieved; not verified as downloadable.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: An 'is ortholog' label would have to be built by running the authors' synteny and alignment pipeline across 13 Ensembl genomes, or by joining supplementary tables to annotations; no ready feature/label table exists in the deposit.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs (lncRNA sequences, genomic positions) would come from Ensembl release 109 genome annotations, not from the deposit.

a4_units_stated.note: Not applicable for a categorical ortholog call; expression in TPM (transcripts per million) per paper text.

a5_enough_rows.note: Paper reports thousands of relaxed ortholog pairs, but only ~200 per species under stringent criteria; not counted in files.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: unknown; annotations a few hundred MB
a6_fits_laptop.note: Gene annotations fit on a laptop; whole-genome alignments would not be needed if using supplements.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Could not compare: result tables not opened.

a8_label_provenance.note: The orthology label is the output of a computational workflow (synteny of flanking protein-coding genes plus multi-genome alignment conservation), not a measurement. Predicting it from genomic context or sequence would distill those rules — circular.

integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Does conserved synteny predict conserved tissue expression of lncRNAs — already answered descriptively by the paper.

honest_claim_h3: A model would only reproduce the authors' synteny-and-alignment rules for calling lncRNA orthologs among Ensembl-annotated vertebrates, not detect true functional orthology.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use a long non-coding RNA's sequence and genomic neighbourhood to predict whether it has a counterpart gene in another vertebrate species.
plain_idea.train_on: Human lncRNAs (long non-coding RNAs, 18,859 per paper) with their sequence and neighbouring genes; number of labelled pairs unknown because the tables were not opened.
plain_idea.predict: Whether each lncRNA has a putative ortholog (evolutionary counterpart) in each of 13 species; the 'true answer' is itself the authors' computational synteny/alignment call, not a lab measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would help prioritise conserved lncRNAs for functional experiments, but the label is rule-derived so a model would learn little beyond the rules.

label_elsewhere.sources: Other lncRNA orthology catalogues exist (e.g., the Hezroni et al. 2015 17-species study cited in the paper); not searched in detail.
label_elsewhere.why: Other catalogues could cross-check calls, but they are also computational, not measured.

ml_idea: Classify lncRNA ortholog presence from sequence embeddings and synteny features; rejected because labels are pipeline outputs and the deposit holds code only.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Open the NAR supplementary tables and confirm a per-lncRNA ortholog table exists; even then A8 circularity stands.

verdict_reason: Fails A8 and A2: the orthology label is a computational pipeline output (synteny plus alignment), not a measurement, and the Zenodo deposit is a 113 KB code archive with no result tables; supplementary tables were not retrievable.
